name: hyperliquid-mcp
description: Hyperliquid (perpetuals) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, list_orders. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_hyperliquid_wallet_address.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HYPERLIQUID_WALLET_ADDRESS
platform_mcp_hyperliquid_wallet_address.description: Public 0x address (42 hex characters) of the MAIN wallet whose orders/balances to read. Not a secret; no private key is needed or accepted. Only list_orders/get_balances use it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public info endpoint, no credentials: the probe posts {"type": "meta"} (weight 20).

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Perpetuals universe (weight 20); every market is quoted in USDC and returned in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent).

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Top of the L2 book (weight 2): levels[0] are bids, levels[1] asks; prices are decimal strings on the wire and are returned as numbers (num:, as the vocabulary types bid/ask). `last`/`volume` are not available per symbol (allMids is a coin-keyed map and metaAndAssetCtxs a positional array the runtime cannot index by symbol).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Open orders of PLATFORM_MCP_HYPERLIQUID_WALLET_ADDRESS (weight 20); `side` is B (bid/buy) or A (ask/sell). `symbol`/`status` are not sent.
